name: XENON
summary: A liquid-xenon direct-detection programme at LNGS, Italy, encompassing XENON10, XENON100, XENON1T and XENONnT. Alongside WIMP nuclear recoils, low-background electron-recoil data probe axions, dark photons and other rare processes.
detection_principle: A dual-phase TPC measures prompt liquid-xenon scintillation S1 and proportional scintillation S2 from drift electrons extracted into gas. Their ratio, drift time and light pattern provide background discrimination and three-dimensional localization.

status.evidence: Official and partner-institution pages identify XENONnT as the current phase without dating the status text. The 2024 detector paper establishes that this generation has achieved science operation.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
